title: Live Vshell C2 operator 'newsakaye' - 4-node HK cluster
bph_link: Netsec Limited (AS45753) - HK host, not currently a tracked BPH entity
summary: A single Vshell C2 operator runs a four-node cluster on Netsec Limited (AS45753, HK), all four Shodan-visible and VirusTotal-flagged as of 2026-09-10, with an exposed MariaDB still on :3306. The nodes share one TLS cert (vshell[.]newsakaye[.]com) and back the same operator tooling domain. Shares the fraud-oriented, HK-hosted, Chinese-C2 profile of the co-reported Gshell activity.
detail: A Vshell C2 cluster on Netsec Limited (AS45753, HK): 52[.]128[.]224[.]234/236/237/238, all live and VirusTotal-flagged (6-15 detections) as of 2026-09-10 on the Vshell C2 port 8084 plus 8089/9090/9191, with MariaDB still exposed on :3306. All four present one shared TLS certificate vshell[.]newsakaye[.]com (serial 0590E720...). The operator domain newsakaye[.]com is dedicated offensive infrastructure - subdomains vshell (C2), rshell (reverse shell) and xss (payload/hook); GoDaddy-registered 2025-07-18, privacy-protected. Nodes also back random-string '...555' scam domains. Note: Netsec is not currently a tracked BPH entity in the dataset; it is a HK commodity host repeatedly backing Chinese C2 and fraud, included as the co-reported partner of the CTG Gshell activity.
